reviews.author: Jeannette
reviews.body: Sally helped us future‑proof our move to the Sunshine Coast and we couldn’t be happier.We were referred to Sally from Baxter & Mason by friends who had used Sally’s services previously. From the very first conversation we knew we were in safe hands. We’re planning to relocate to the Sunshine Coast in a few years and wanted to buy an investment property now to set ourselves up for the future.Initially, we were looking at high‑yielding units, but Sally took the time to explain the realities of unit ownership - body corporate fees, sinking funds, special levies and the fact that units often don’t grow in value as strongly as houses. She didn’t push us; she educated us. It completely changed our thinking.Sally showed us the benefits of dual‑income properties compared to units or houses at the same price point, and the strategy made perfect sense for our long‑term goals.Thanks to her guidance, we purchased a beautiful dual‑income property in Palmwoods with an approx 5.2% rental yield. It wasn’t a standard builder‑grade investment - it had a lovely finish, a big yard, great layout and strong rental appeal. The numbers stacked up perfectly, and the property gives us multiple options when we move to the Coast.We can sell and use the equity to buy our dream home, or we can live in the 3‑bedroom side and continue earning rent from the 2‑bedroom unit. It’s flexible, smart and exactly what we needed.Sally is professional, experienced, empathetic and incredibly thorough. She made the whole process easy and stress‑free, and we genuinely felt she cared about our future, not just the purchase.We highly recommend Sally to anyone looking for a buyers agent on the Sunshine Coast – Dean & Jeannette

reviews.author: Jaimie Bowers-Anstis
reviews.body: After relocating and searching on our own for a month we knew we needed help, Baxter & Mason came highly recommended. Sally did not disappoint. She works tirelessly, professionally and she is by your side every step of the way. In the current tough market her insight, early access to properties and strong industry connections makes her skills irreplaceable. I have never worked with a professional that cares so deeply about achieving your goals. I cannot recommend Baxter & Mason highly enough. Thank you Sally!

reviews.author: Will Van den Dungen
reviews.body: Working with Sally from Baxter & Mason Property Buyers Agent is always a standout experience. As a selling agent, I genuinely appreciate when a buyer’s agent brings professionalism, clarity, and genuine care to the table - and Sally delivers that every time.She is exceptionally organised, communicates with ease, and approaches every negotiation with respect and collaboration. Her clients are always well‑prepared, well‑informed, and supported, which makes the entire process smoother for everyone involved.Sally is hardworking, detail‑driven, and an absolute pleasure to deal with. I highly recommend her to any buyer looking for a dedicated advocate who truly goes above and beyond. ~ Will - Ray White Sunshine Coast

reviews.author: Jamie Hill
reviews.body: I recently had the pleasure of working with Sally on a property transaction where she was acting as the buyer's agent, and I couldn't have been more impressed with her professionalism throughout the entire process.Sally was proactive, communicative and always focused on achieving the best outcome for her client while maintaining a respectful and collaborative approach with all parties involved. She was well prepared, transparent in her dealings and helped ensure the transaction progressed smoothly from start to finish.As an agent, you quickly recognise the people in the industry who genuinely add value to a transaction, and Sally is certainly one of those professionals. It was a pleasure working alongside her, and I look forward to doing more business together in the future.I would have no hesitation in recommending Sally to anyone looking for a knowledgeable, professional and dedicated buyer's agent searching on the Sunshine Coast.

reviews.author: Carmel Fulton
reviews.body: Working with Sally from Baxter & Mason has been one of the greatest privileges of my business journey. As small business owners, we both understand the value of genuine collaboration, and Sally embodies everything you could hope for in a trusted professional partner. She is supportive, generous with her knowledge, and always willing to lend a hand wherever she can — and that spirit of teamwork has strengthened our working relationship in the best possible way.Sally is innovative, incredibly hard‑working and has an exceptional eye for detail. She approaches every client and every property with care, strategy and heart. Her communication is seamless, she’s organised, proactive and consistently goes above and beyond to ensure her buyers feel informed, supported and confident throughout the entire process.I cannot recommend Sally highly enough to anyone looking for a dedicated, ethical and deeply committed buyers agent. She is a true asset to the Sunshine Coast property community, and I’m grateful to work alongside her. ~ Carmel – Fulton and Co Property

reviews.author: Alana Russell
reviews.body: Moving interstate with two kids felt extremely overwhelming and intimidating. Sally became our eyes and ears on the ground to help us weed through all of the properties. Her videos were detailed and clear, giving us the confidence to choose the right property for us.From the beginning, Sally was knowledgeable and professional and genuinely dedicated to helping us find the right property. She was completely honest throughout her walk throughs and her attention to detail was obvious.We are extremely thankful to Sally for making our move to the Sunshine Coast less stressful and more manageable. We would not hesitate to recommend Sally to anyone moving to the Sunny Coast! Thanks again Sally!

reviews.author: Matthew Shelley
reviews.body: Working with Sally from Baxter & Mason Property Buyers Agent made purchasing my home at auction such a positive experience. As a single buyer looking for a renovator to start building my property portfolio, I really valued having someone I could trust to guide me on pricing, renovation potential and what would add value long‑term.Sally supported me through the entire four‑week campaign leading up to auction, kept me informed, and helped me feel confident and prepared on the day. I fell in love with the property as soon as she presented it, and with her strategy and calm guidance, we stuck to the budget and secured it successfully.I couldn’t have done this without her. If you’re buying - especially if you want expert advice and genuine support - I highly recommend Sally and Baxter & Mason. ~ Matt

reviews.author: Jordan Barden (SOLDBYJORDY)
reviews.body: Working with Sally from Baxter & Mason Property Buyers Agent on the sale of 6 Essex Place, Buderim was an outstanding experience. Sally represented her buyer, Matt, with professionalism, calm confidence and genuine care - especially impressive given he was a nervous buyer heading into auction.Her preparation, communication and support on the day made a huge difference. Sally kept the process smooth, positive and well coordinated from start to finish, and it was clear her guidance gave Matt the reassurance he needed to step forward and secure the property. Without her involvement, I’m not sure the result would have been the same.As an agent, it’s refreshing to work alongside someone who is organised, respectful and truly invested in achieving the best outcome for their client. I’d happily work with Sally again anytime.

reviews.author: Sarah Roberts
reviews.body: Working with Sally from Baxter & Mason Property Buyers Agent on the purchase of 14 Bushbird Court, Diddillibah was an absolute pleasure. From our very first interaction, she was professional, polite, punctual and incredibly easy to deal with. Sally’s communication was exceptional throughout the entire process, and she consistently went above and beyond to ensure everything progressed smoothly for her clients.In a market that can feel fast paced and high pressure, Sally brought calm, clarity and genuine care. Her knowledge of the Sunshine Coast market is outstanding, and her commitment to achieving the best outcome for her buyers was evident every step of the way.I couldn’t have been happier with the experience. Thank you, Sally - you were wonderful to work with, and I look forward to many more opportunities together. ~ Sarah C21

reviews.author: Tracey Rose
reviews.body: We couldn’t be happier with Baxter & Mason Property Buyers. We initially planned to buy a house for our SMSF, but the rental return wouldn’t deliver the growth we needed. Sally guided us toward a dual income property and, despite the scarcity in our price range, secured an excellent off market Landsborough investment for us. The whole process was handled professionally and stress free from start to finish. Highly recommend Baxter & Mason, thank you Sally - Tracey & Grant.

reviews.author: S J
reviews.body: As first home buyers working in Birtinya, we wanted to be as close to work as possible and had a firm budget. We've been searching for months but always miss out. We didn't want to compromise by buying in Aura or Palmview because peak hour drives to Birtinya can be brutal. Sally understood our priorities and secured a 3 bed 2.5 bath terrace home pre auction and right within our budget. She was always on hand to answer our questions, worked tirelessly throughout the search (even on weekends!) and made the buying process so much smoother. We feel so lucky and can't thank Sally enough. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Nicki Colam
reviews.body: As a sales agent, I have recently worked with Sally on the sale of two homes on the Sunshine Coast.Communication was always clear, timely and friendly, which really helped keep everything stress-free for all involved. Sally’s professionalism and proactive approach gave us great confidence throughout the process, and made it easy for us to in turn reassure our clients every step of the way.We look forward to the opportunity to work with Sally again in the future.

reviews.author: Madeline Fabian
reviews.body: Sally was absolutely fabulous throughout the entire process. For me, communication is everything, and Sally truly delivered. She was always available on the phone when I needed to speak with her and consistently quick to respond to any questions or concerns. It made such a difference knowing I could rely on her to keep me informed every step of the way.Sally is incredibly efficient, knowledgeable, and clearly experienced in what she does. Her professionalism and straightforward approach gave me a lot of confidence, and I always felt like I was in very capable hands.I wouldn’t hesitate to recommend Sally to anyone thinking about buying property.

reviews.author: Deb Ward
reviews.body: VALUEThe thought of engaging a buyer’s agent may initially feel like an unnecessary expense. However, my experience working with Sally from Baxter & Mason has proven it to be the most beneficial decisions I could have made. The financial investment was far outweighed by the savings achieved during negotiations and on the purchase price of my property. Beyond the monetary benefits, the competitive advantages and overall peace of mind provided were invaluable.LOCAL KNOWLEDGEBeing a Sunshine Coast resident, Sally’s extensive network with local agents meant she was able to access off-market and pre-market properties that I would have otherwise missed. These professional relationships were fundamental in identifying properties that suited my needs, ensuring I was presented with the best possible options.SUPPORTDue to my inability to attend inspections, Sally acted as my eyes and ears. Her thorough processes allowed her to understand exactly what would work for me, and she consistently played devil’s advocate, offering brutally honest feedback when required. This approach ensured my interests were always prioritized and helped me make informed decisions throughout the purchasing process.So, if you are after an honest and dedicated professional to reduce the stress of buying a property, I cannot recommend Baxter & Mason highly enough. You won’t be disappointed.Deb

reviews.author: Jenny Neill
reviews.body: Relocating to the Sunshine Coast to start work at SCUH was a huge step, and I’m so grateful to have had Sally from Baxter & Mason Property Buyers Agent guiding me through the process. My search was very specific - I needed a home in Birtinya, within walking distance to the hospital, big enough to live comfortably, but still affordable and a smart investment for the future.Despite low stock in the area, Sally went above and beyond. She sourced several off market and pre market opportunities, and ultimately helped us secure a fantastic on market property that ticked all the boxes. Her knowledge of yields, property prices, and what would be the best fit for us was invaluable.Thanks to Sally’s expertise and negotiation skills, we’ll be moving into our new home in January, ready to start our next chapter at SCUH. I couldn’t recommend Baxter & Mason more highly for anyone looking for professional guidance and genuine support in their property journey.

reviews.author: Goog Brocks
reviews.body: Living interstate, we knew we wanted to secure a home now to avoid paying higher prices when we’re ready to relocate in a couple of years. The challenge was that we weren’t entirely sure of the suburb or even the style of house we wanted. Sally from Baxter & Mason was incredibly patient, guiding us through the process and helping us clarify what would suit us best.In the end, she helped us secure a modern ex‑display home - perfectly suited with room for our caravan and space for a pool. Sally’s negotiation skills saved us money, as we would have been tempted to accept the vendor’s asking price, but she stayed firm and worked hard on our behalf.Throughout the journey, Sally was professional, hardworking, and communicated brilliantly, keeping us updated every step of the way. Using Sally wasn’t just hiring a buyers agent - it was partnering with someone who genuinely cared about our outcome. This is the best investment we’ve ever made, and we couldn’t be happier with both her service and our purchase. We’re excited about relocating in the near future, knowing we’ve already secured the perfect home. ~ Julie & Trevor

reviews.author: Peter Johnson
reviews.body: Relocating from Canberra for a sea change was a big step, and I’m so glad I had Baxter & Mason Property Buyers Agent by my side. From the very beginning, Sally took the time to understand exactly what I was looking for - something modern, low maintenance, and with low body corporate fees. Her guidance was professional, insightful, and always reassuring.Together we found the perfect fit: a 2‑bed, 2‑bath unit in the Hedge complex at Buddina. It ticked every box - close to the beach and amenities, yet away from the hustle and tourist crowds. Sally’s knowledge of the Sunshine Coast market was invaluable, and she made the entire buying process smooth and stress‑free.I couldn’t be happier with my new home and the lifestyle it offers. If you’re considering a move or looking for a property advocate who truly listens and delivers, I highly recommend Baxter & Mason. ~ Peter

reviews.author: Leanne King
reviews.body: I worked with Sally to help her secure a property for an interstate client who was making the move to the Sunshine Coast. I found Sally to be of good character, very honest with good integrity and a true professional. The whole experience with Sally has been super transparent and the communication along the way was second to none! I would recommend using Sally Blyth from Baxter and Mason Property Buyers Agent when searching for the right coastal home or investment property so do not hesitate to give Sally a call as she is a hard worker and will be dedicated in finding the right property for you!

reviews.author: joshh rhods
reviews.body: After searching for a property for quite some time and continually missing out, I reached out to Sally from Baxter & Mason Property Buyers Agent. Within just 3 days of signing up, she found and secured an off‑market property for me. Sally worked tirelessly, even negotiating late into a Friday night to make sure the deal was done. She was professional, a great communicator, and clearly very knowledgeable about the market. Her strong connections with selling agents gave me the edge to secure my new home without the stress or pressure of competing in a multiple‑offer situation. I couldn’t be happier with the outcome and highly recommend Sally to anyone looking for a dedicated and hardworking buyers agent. ~ Josh

reviews.author: Bruno Goes
reviews.body: As first-home buyers living interstate, we had no idea where to start with the Sunshine Coast market. Working with Sally at Baxter & Mason Property Buyers Agent made everything so much easier. She took the time to understand what we were looking for, was proactive with inspections, and gave us straight-up, honest feedback. She found us a place that actually fits our needs, close to the beach and still within our budget. We felt well supported the whole way through and would happily recommend her to anyone looking for a buyer’s agent on the Sunshine Coast.

reviews.author: edwinlimque
reviews.body: Working with Sally from Baxter & Mason Property Buyers Agent was an excellent experience. Her communication was clear, transparent, and always professional, which made the process smooth from start to finish. She was proactive in assisting her young first home buyers, ensuring the deal was completed quickly and without unnecessary delays. What stood out most was her straightforward approach - no games, just an honest transaction handled with integrity. Sally’s dedication to her clients and collaborative style made the entire process seamless. I would highly recommend her to anyone looking for a buyer’s agent who truly advocates for their clients. ~ Edwin

reviews.author: Britany HATTON
reviews.body: We can't thank Sally from Baxter & Mason Property Buyers Agent enough for helping us secure our beautiful modern duplex and making our move back to our hometown a reality.As first home buyers, we knew the market was fast-moving and competitive, but Sally was an absolute powerhouse. Within just 10 days of signing with her, she had inspected 17 properties and even secured us an off-market deal - which we ultimately passed on due to major building and pest concerns. But Sally didn’t stop there.Having exhausted most of the on-market options, she went above and beyond by reaching out on social media and connecting directly with the owner of the duplex we now call home. Her ability to negotiate and secure the deal was nothing short of impressive.Sally was professional, attentive, and genuinely invested in helping us find the right property. Her dedication and hard work made all the difference, and we’re so grateful to have had her in our corner during this journey.Highly recommend Baxter & Mason to anyone looking for a buyer’s agent who truly goes the extra mile!Britany & Luke

reviews.author: Maini Homer
reviews.body: Sally helped me big time last year when I was purchasing my family home. She was a wealth of knowledge about property here on the Sunshine Coast and it was nice to know that someone was in my corner. Thanks for your help Sally!

reviews.author: Carolyn Dowse
reviews.body: Baxter & Mason Property Buyers Agent advised us against purchasing a unit due to body corporate fees and steered us toward more promising options. Their strategic focus on the Sunshine Coast, particularly around Maroochydore and beaches like Buddina and Bokarina, was spot on. Thanks to their insight, we ended up investing in a nearly new dual key house just a short walk from the beach — a property that offers excellent rental income, impressive yields, and fantastic lifestyle benefits.

reviews.author: Team Sof and Chris
reviews.body: We had a fantastic experience with Sally from Baxter & Mason Buyers Agent. She was attentive to our clients very specific needs and tight budget. She held their hand every step of the way and didn't give up even when the usual obstacles of buying/selling prop up. She is caring, approachable and ensures they get the best deal negotiated. Look forward to working together again if you're needing a buyers agent on the Sunshine Coast. Highly recommend.

reviews.author: David White
reviews.body: We had an excellent experience with Baxter & Mason Property Buyers Agent and couldn’t be happier with the outcome. As astute property investors, our main focus was finding a property that offers both strong rental yield and good capital growth—ideally on the eastern side of the highway from Caloundra through to Coolum.Sally from Baxter & Mason worked tirelessly for us, demonstrating remarkable dedication and availability at all hours to discuss options and update us. We often told her she was doing an incredible job, and we truly appreciated her patience, especially since we were quite particular about the type of property, location, and yield we wanted. Despite our specific criteria, Sally presented us with numerous off-market, pre-market, and on-market options, always keeping our best interests in mind.In the end, we purchased a fantastic 4-bedroom, 3-bath, 2-car home with a pool, located within walking distance to Mooloolaba shops and beaches. It wasn’t even on our radar initially, but it checked all our boxes for both growth potential and rental income. Her market knowledge, professionalism, and courteous approach made the entire buying process smooth and enjoyable.We highly recommend Baxter & Mason Property Buyers Agent to anyone looking for a dedicated and knowledgeable team to help find their investment property. Thanks to Sally and the team, we’re confident we’ve secured a property that will serve our investment goals well.

reviews.author: Drew Small
reviews.body: I had a wonderful experience with Baxter & Mason Property Buyers Agent while searching for an investment property that would not only yield good returns but also serve as a future retirement home in the next 8-10 years.Sally, my agent, expertly identified an ideal opportunity in the vibrant Maroochydore city centre. She recommended this location due to its promising future developments, including a new private hospital, an Olympic stadium, and a proposed train station.The unit I purchased boasts views of the new parkland, lift access, and strong rental potential. Working with Sally was a delight; she was proactive in finding the right investment, coordinated all inspections, and even attended them personally to provide her insights.I can thoroughly recommend the services of Baxter & Mason, Sally made the entire process smooth and stress-free.Thank you, Sally, for all your assistance.RegardsDrew Small

reviews.author: Samuel White
reviews.body: Sally Blyth was Absolutely wonderful to deal with. Very communicative with not only myself, but the finance team,conveyancers and property managers. Made every single aspect of the transaction really easy and I would highly Baxter & Mason Property Buyers Agent to any and all looking to buy a home.

reviews.author: Louise Dever
reviews.body: I find the process of dealing with selling agents emotionally overwhelming, so I decided to hire a buyer’s agent to handle the heavy lifting for me.As a sole-income household and working to a very tight budget, Sally did an incredible job securing a 2-bedroom unit that came with a fantastic bonus family room. The path to finalising this deal was not without its challenges, but thanks to Sally’s dedication and collaboration with the selling agent, we successfully reached settlement.I am truly grateful for Sally’s support throughout this journey. She was always quick to respond to my questions, available for discussions when I needed guidance, and consistently went above and beyond to help me find a place to call home. I can confidently say that I will never purchase property without a buyer’s agent again, and I wholeheartedly recommend Baxter & Mason Property Buyers to anyone looking for assistance in the market.

reviews.author: Jens Boehme
reviews.body: Relocating from Brisbane to the Sunshine Coast, I started looking at properties for sale. It was a tedious process, living and working at one end, and trying to organise viewings with agents hard to get hold of at the other end a great distance away. My search was also hampered by my rather slim budget, and the low number of properties being offered at that end of the market. I missed out on a number of potential properties in this fashion.That‘s when I decided to hire Sally from Baxter & Mason Property Buyers Agent, who came highly recommended. She turned things around very quickly for me. Her local expertise, combined with her agency contacts resulted in a list of opportunities, some of which had not yet been put on the market. She conducted the initial viewings, took photos and videos, so I did not have to travel to and fro, and had an easy task of shortlisting them for later inspection by myself.Sally negotiated on price as well. And once I had decided on the one property, she also bargained for favourable settlement conditions, to tie in with the sale of my old property, working with my sales agent. She had all angles covered, leaving nothing open to chance. Thanks very much, Sally, for a job well done.
